name: Tenrai (MyAnimeList data)
description: Anime facts, cover and trailers for titles that state a MyAnimeList id, from Tenrai's public API (beta; no account or key). Looked up by that exact id only: never by title. Data from MyAnimeList via Tenrai, with no uptime or freshness guarantee; artwork and text remain their owners'. Trailers play in YouTube's official embedded player.
